# Data dictionary (generated by `_build/prepare.py`)

Clean tables in `data/clean/` (CSV UTF-8, ISO dates; parquet copies). Currency is not stated in the source; shown as INR. Dropped everywhere: customer_name, email, phone, address, store_id, delivery_partner_id (5,000 unique ids), feedback_text, stored customer total_orders / avg_order_value, stored roas, daily inventory file.

## fact_orders

One row per order (5,000). Orders, one item line, delivery and feedback merged 1:1. Source: orders, order_items, delivery_performance, customer_feedback. Rows: 5,000.

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| order_id | int64 | Order key (unique). |
| customer_id | int64 | FK to dim_customer. |
| product_id | int64 | FK to dim_product (one item per order). |
| order_date | datetime64[us] | Order date (day). |
| order_datetime | datetime64[us] | Order timestamp, ISO. |
| order_hour | int32 | Hour of day 0-23. |
| month_start | datetime64[us] | First day of the order month (join to a Date table). |
| is_full_month | bool | False for the partial months Mar 2023 and Nov 2024; exclude from trends and YoY. |
| order_total | float64 | Order header total in assumed INR. THE revenue measure (revenue, AOV, Revenue at Risk). |
| line_value | float64 | quantity x unit_price. Only for category/product mix; does not reconcile to order_total (total 4.97M vs 11.01M). |
| quantity | int64 | Units on the item line (1-3). |
| unit_price | float64 | Item unit price. |
| payment_method | str | Card, Cash, UPI or Wallet. |
| delivery_status | str | On Time, Slightly Delayed or Significantly Delayed. |
| minutes_late | int64 | Actual minus promised delivery time, minutes (-5 to 30; negative = early). |
| is_late | bool | Significantly Delayed or minutes_late > 5 (equals status not On Time). |
| distance_km | float64 | Delivery distance. |
| delay_reason | str | Stored reason; only 'Traffic' or blank (also set on some on-time rows, do not analyse). |
| rating | int64 | Customer rating 1-5. |
| sentiment | str | Positive, Neutral or Negative. |
| feedback_category | str | Delivery, Customer Service, Product Quality or App Experience. |
| poor_experience | bool | is_late OR rating <= 2. Basis of Revenue at Risk. |

## fact_marketing

One row per campaign record (5,400). No key to orders. Rows: 5,400.

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| campaign_id | int64 | Row id (not a campaign key). |
| campaign_name | str | 9 campaign names. |
| date | datetime64[us] | Record date. |
| month_start | datetime64[us] | First day of month. |
| is_full_month | bool | False for Mar 2023 and Nov 2024; exclude from trends and YoY. |
| channel | str | App, Email, SMS or Social Media. |
| target_audience | str | All, Inactive, New Users or Premium. |
| impressions | int64 | Impressions. |
| clicks | int64 | Clicks. |
| conversions | int64 | Conversions. |
| spend | float64 | Campaign spend, assumed INR. |
| attributed_revenue | float64 | Source revenue_generated; attributed, not order revenue (2.9x orders total). |
| roas | float64 | Recomputed attributed_revenue / spend (stored roas dropped: it did not match). Aggregate in DAX as SUM/SUM. |

## fact_inventory

Product x month (inventoryNew summed; daily 'inventory' file dropped, 54% damage rate). Rows: 5,571.

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| product_id | int64 | FK to dim_product. |
| month_start | datetime64[us] | First day of month (source 'Mon-YY'). |
| stock_received | int64 | Units received, summed. |
| damaged_stock | int64 | Units damaged, summed. |
| is_full_month | bool | False for Mar 2023 and Nov 2024. |

## dim_product

One row per product (268). Rows: 268.

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| product_id | int64 | Key. |
| product_name | str | Name (only 51 distinct; not unique). |
| product_label | str | Name plus id, unique; use in visuals. |
| category | str | 11 categories. |
| brand | str | Brand (about one per product; not useful). |
| price | float64 | List price. |
| mrp | float64 | Maximum retail price. |
| margin_percentage | float64 | Stored margin %, 15-40. |
| shelf_life_days | int64 | Shelf life. |
| min_stock_level | int64 | Min stock level. |
| max_stock_level | int64 | Max stock level. |

## dim_customer

One row per customer in customers.csv (2,500; 2,172 have orders). Name, email, phone, address removed. Metrics derived from orders, not from customers.csv. Rows: 2,500.

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | int64 | Key. |
| area | str | Area. |
| pincode | int64 | Pincode. |
| registration_date | datetime64[us] | Stored registration date (unreliable: 2,556 orders precede it). |
| segment | str | Stored segment: Regular, Premium, New, Inactive. |
| first_order_date | datetime64[us] | Earliest order date; blank if no orders. |
| orders | int64 | Order count from fact_orders. |
| revenue | float64 | Sum of order_total from fact_orders. |
| customer_type | str | New = 1 order, Repeat = 2+ orders, No orders = 0. |
